full_judgment: "Provided that if, in the course of a trial before a Special Magistrate, the offence appears to him to warrant a presumption that the case is one which calls for higher penalty than he is empowered to award, he shall stay the proceedings and submit the case with a brief report, explaining its nature, to a Special Tribunal which shall, on such submission, try the case ;
